messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran NTK+YARN ramp on qwen-14b this morning. At seq_len=8192 we saw tail latency jump ~15% and a burst of KV cache misses that line up with kernel fallback windows.
maya: can you paste the profiler snippet? which kernel fell back?
alex: nvprof snapshot attached in the job but short version: attention kernel switched from `fused_attn_v2` -> `attn_generic` around token 8120, plus increased memcpys.
maya: ugh. that lines up with the padding/batch reshuffle heuristic. we trigger an unbatched path when avg_seq_len > 6k for qwen config.
jin: are we sure it's the kernel switch and not kv eviction policy? i saw some cases where head_kv dims misalign and we drop to host staging.
alex: checked GPU memmap — not host staging. it's device memcpy spikes right before kernel change. also observed throughput variance when batcher groups a short request with a long one.
sam: proposal: tweak batching heuristic to prefer homogeneous sequence groups for ctx>4096 and force `--kernel=fused_attn_v2` where validated. but that risks OOM for some Mistral variants.
maya: can we gate by model-safe-range? e.g., for mixtral-8b allow fused to 12k linear, for mistral-7b cap at 10k, for qwen-14b NTK variant cap at 6k. those numbers came from last sweep (see eval-run 2026-02-11).
jin: those caps match my local perplexity tests — beyond those lengths NTK-style RoPE scaling shows perplexity drift. we should record both perf and quality SLOs before forcing kernels.
ci-bot: perf-job-1945678901 finished: failures=2, median_latency_ms=48, p99_latency_ms=320, kv_miss_rate=0.013. See https://ci/redwood/job/1945678901
sam: thanks. i think we need a dual approach: 1) adjust batcher to avoid mixing long+short when long>threshold, 2) add kernel routing policy that prefers stable kernels for models/time windows flagged by evals.
maya: for 1) small change — add a `max_batch_span` param (default 2048) so we don't merge seq_len 8192 with seq_len 128. quick patch, low risk. for 2) we need a mapping table: model -> (safe_rope_variant, max_seq, preferred_kernel). i'll start a draft.
jin: also running a KV cache footprint profiler to see if head_kv dims cause alignment issues with our shard packing. results expected EOD.
alex: question — do we log when kernel fallback happens and which reason code triggered it? that would help correlate.
sam: yes, we have kernel_events in trace but not surfaced in console. i'll add an alert when kernel swaps cause p99>baseline*1.2.
maya: small note — for Mistral family linear RoPE is stable up to ~12k in our tests but NTK gives slightly better long-range quality at cost of jittery kernels. we should default to linear for production unless evals mandate NTK.
jin: agree. add per-model eval tags in model catalog: `rope_preferred=linear|ntk|yarn` and `rope_safe_max_seq`.
alex: ok team — action items: maya drafts mapping + PR for max_batch_span; sam adds kernel swap alert; jin finishes KV profiler; i'll re-run the qwen sweep with homogeneous batching and attach logs.
maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/patch/3821 (max_batch_span + batch grouping changelog). PTAL.
ci-bot: deploy-checks passed for PR 3821.
alex: thanks — re-running jobs now. i'll post a short summary when done. :thumbsup:
